hints.title: Equal Subarray Values
hints.text: If a == b, then a ^ b = 0. Thus the bitwise xor sum of subarray arr[i..k] must equal 0.

hints.title: Prefix Bitwise Values
hints.text: The bitwise xor sum of arr[i..k] is pref[k + 1] ^ pref[i]. It is 0 whenever pref[k + 1] == pref[i].

hints.title: Any Split j is Valid
hints.text: Whenever pref[k + 1] == pref[i], any index j with i < j <= k yields a == b, contributing k - i triplets.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute force checking all triplets (i, j, k) takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since any j between i + 1 and k works when pref[i] == pref[k + 1], O(N^2) or O(N) prefix counting suffices.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate deduces that a == b means total XOR from i to k is 0, adding k - i triplets.

solutions.approach: prefix XOR equality counting over pairs (i, k)
